info.title: e-Invoicing Custom API v1.1
info.description:
## Disclaimer **** Warning: at this point, ITAS API does not support asynchronous or multithreading calls for POST, PUT, PATCH and DELETE requests. Async or multithreading requests could result in various Error messages, or even a corruption of data in extreme cases and are therefore not supported. ****

Release notes (6th February 2026.) ## New Endpoints
  • None
## Updated Endpoints
  • Invoices Incoming Invoice Record List: Additional Properties Notes and DocmanDocumentId, Link
  • Invoices Incoming Invoice Record Create: Additional Properties Notes and DocmanDocumentId, Link
  • Invoices Incoming Invoice Record Update: Additional Properties Notes and DocmanDocumentId, Link
** ends **
